app.title: ESP FlashJS
app.tagline: Inspect, analyze and modify ESP32 flash directly from your browser.
browser.unsupported.title: This browser cannot connect to devices
browser.unsupported.body: Web Serial is required to talk to a device, and is available in Chrome, Edge and other Chromium-based desktop browsers. You can still import binary files and analyze them offline.
browser.insecureContext: Web Serial requires a secure context. Open this page over HTTPS, or over http://localhost during development.
device.romModeWarning: Running from the ROM loader. Reading and erasing flash are unavailable because the ROM does not implement those commands; writing still works.
device.secureDownloadMode: Secure Download Mode is enabled on this chip. Reading flash and loading the stub are blocked by the hardware.
device.encryptionEnabled: Flash encryption is enabled. Partition contents will be unreadable, and writing plaintext will make them unusable.
flash.systemRegion: Reserved by the boot process. Not free space — overwriting it can stop the device from booting.
files.empty: No files loaded. Import a .bin file to analyze it without a device.
partition.label: Label
inspector.empty: Select a partition or a file to inspect it.
inspector.notRead: This region has not been read yet.
confirm.title: Confirm a destructive operation
confirm.dangerous: This region is critical. Writing incorrect data here can leave the device unable to boot.
confirm.backedUp: A backup of this region has been saved.
confirm.notBackedUp: This region has not been backed up.
confirm.encrypted: This partition is marked encrypted. Writing plaintext to it will corrupt it from the device's point of view.
analyze.possiblyEncrypted: High entropy and no recognizable structure. This region may be encrypted; it is not being interpreted.
analyze.unsupportedShort: reading this format is not implemented yet
analyze.notImplemented: This looks like a {format} partition. Parsing {format} is planned for Phase {phase} and is not implemented yet, so the contents are shown as raw bytes. The Hex tab and Export still work.
raw.entropy.high: high; may be compressed or encrypted
image.checksumMismatch: Segment checksum does not match: expected {expected}, computed {actual}.
image.truncatedSegment: Segment {index} claims {length} bytes but only {available} are present.
image.truncatedSegmentHeader: Header declares {declared} segments but the data ends after {index}.
image.truncatedChecksum: The image ends before its checksum byte.
image.truncatedHash: The image declares an appended SHA-256 that is not present.
otadata.neverWritten: No OTA update has been recorded; the device boots the factory application.
otadata.noValidSector: Neither OTA data sector has a valid checksum.
partition.md5Mismatch: Partition table checksum does not match: expected {expected}, computed {actual}.
partition.rawHead: First 16 bytes at {offset}: {bytes} — kept as a raw buffer in Files so it can be inspected.
partition.tooMany: {count} entries exceed the {max} the table can hold.
partition.appAlignment: App partition "{label}" starts at {offset}, which is not a 64 KB boundary.
partition.dataAlignment: Data partition "{label}" starts at {offset}, which is not a 4 KB boundary.
partition.overlapsTable: Partition "{label}" starts inside the bootloader or partition table area.
partition.exceedsFlash: Partition "{label}" ends past the end of flash.
partition.duplicateLabel: Label "{label}" is used more than once.
partition.missingOtaData: {count} OTA slots are defined but there is no otadata partition.
partition.singleOtaSlot: Only one OTA slot is defined; over-the-air updates need at least two.
partition.factoryWithOta: Both a factory partition and OTA slots are defined.
error.SYNC_FAILED: Could not synchronize with the device. Hold the BOOT button, press EN, then try again.
error.UNKNOWN_CHIP: This chip is not recognized. Flash operations are unavailable.
error.STUB_LOAD_FAILED: The flasher stub could not be loaded.
error.SECURE_DOWNLOAD_MODE: Secure Download Mode blocks this operation.
error.REQUIRES_STUB: This operation needs the flasher stub, which is not loaded.
error.VERIFY_FAILED: Verification failed: what was read back differs from what was written.
error.INVALID_MAGIC: This data is not in the expected format.
error.TRUNCATED_DATA: The data ends earlier than its structure requires.
error.BAD_ALIGNMENT: The address or size is not correctly aligned.
error.OUT_OF_RANGE: The requested range lies outside the flash.
error.NVS_CAPACITY: The NVS data does not fit in the partition.
error.UNKNOWN_FLASH_SIZE: The flash size could not be detected.
protocol.securityInfo: Security info: chip id {chipId}, API version {apiVersion}.
protocol.securityInfoUnavailable: GET_SECURITY_INFO unavailable ({message}); falling back to the magic register.
protocol.unknownChipId: Chip id {chipId} is not in the chip table.
protocol.unknownMagic: Magic value {magic} is not in the chip table.
protocol.magicReadFailed: Could not read the magic register ({message}).
protocol.stubLoadFailed: Could not load the stub ({message}); continuing with the ROM loader.
protocol.stubBlockedBySdm: Secure Download Mode prevents loading the stub.
protocol.baudRateUnsupported: This transport cannot change baud rate.
flash.readDigestMismatch: The digest reported by the device does not match the data received.
op.rereadSame: Re-read {name} at {address}: identical to the previous read.
op.rereadDiffers: Re-read {name} at {address}: the contents CHANGED since the last read. The earlier copy has been replaced.
device.baudRate.hint: Which rates a board accepts is not predictable from the outside: it depends on the USB bridge, the cable and the host, and faster is not always more reliable. Just pick one — the link is tested after connecting and drops back to 115200 if it does not hold.
op.linkFast: Link raised to {baudRate} baud and verified.
op.linkFallback: {baudRate} baud did not hold on this link, so it stayed at {fallback}. Reads will be slower but correct.
flash.readRetry: Read at {address} failed ({message}); retrying, attempt {attempt} of {attempts}.
fs.units.hint: Storage units the file occupies: SPIFFS pages, LittleFS blocks or FAT clusters.
fs.partial.hint: Some of this file's data is missing from the image. What survived can still be extracted; the gaps read as zeros.
fs.noFiles: No files. The partition may be formatted but empty, or never formatted at all.
nvs.edit.unsupported: Blobs are not editable here: a text box is the wrong instrument for arbitrary bytes.
nvs.apply.hint: Rebuilds the partition image from these edits and writes it, after backing up what is there now.
nvs.apply.readonly: This image came from a file, so there is nowhere to write it back to.
nvs.erased.hint: Superseded by a later write, or deleted. NVS leaves these behind until it garbage collects, and they are what shows a device has actually been in service.
nvs.pending.hint: Nothing has been written yet. This is exactly what a write would change.
confirm.nvsChanges: {count} NVS entries will change. The partition is rebuilt and rewritten in full.
diff.needTwo: Load or read two buffers to compare them. After a write, the backup and the re-read are already here.
diff.truncated: Showing the first {shown} of {total} differing runs.
analyze.encrypted: Encrypted (entropy {entropy}). Flash encryption is on, so these bytes cannot be read as their format.
analyze.highEntropy: No structure visible (entropy {entropy}). Flash encryption is off, so this is most likely compressed or already-random data rather than ciphertext.
nvs.notFlashEncrypted: Flash encryption does not cover NVS. This partition is stored in the clear unless NVS encryption was enabled separately, with its own key in an nvs_keys partition.
nvs.likelyEncrypted: No readable pages, and the bytes have no structure. This is more likely NVS encryption than an empty partition.
protocol.revisionUnknown: Could not read the silicon revision ({message}); using the default stub.
